import Mathlib

abbrev Bytes := List UInt8

def b32AlphabetGet (i : Nat) : UInt8 :=
  let idx := i % 32
  if idx < 26 then UInt8.ofNat (65 + idx)
  else UInt8.ofNat (24 + idx)

def revAlphabet (c : UInt8) : Option Nat :=
  let n := c.toNat
  if 65 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 90 then some (n - 65)
  else if 50 ≤ n ∧ n ≤ 55 then some (n - 24)
  else none

theorem revAlphabet_b32AlphabetGet (i : Nat) :
    revAlphabet (b32AlphabetGet i) = some (i % 32) := by
  unfold revAlphabet b32AlphabetGet
  dsimp only
  split_ifs <;> simp_all [UInt8.toNat_ofNat] <;> omega

theorem b32AlphabetGet_ne_eq (i : Nat) :

  unfold b32AlphabetGet
  dsimp only
  split_ifs <;> simp [UInt8.toNat_ofNat] <;> omega

theorem nat_and_31 (n : Nat) : n &&& 0x1F = n % 32 := by
  change n &&& (2^5 - 1) = n % 2^5
  exact Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod n 5

theorem nat_and_255 (n : Nat) : n &&& 0xFF = n % 256 := by
  change n &&& (2^8 - 1) = n % 2^8
  exact Nat.and_two_pow_sub_one_eq_mod n 8

theorem shiftLeft5_or_eq (v d : Nat) (hd : d < 32) : (v <<< 5) ||| d = v * 32 + d := by
  have hd' : d < 2^5 := hd
  rw [show v * 32 = 2^5 * v by omega]
  apply Nat.eq_of_testBit_eq
  intro i
  rw [Nat.testBit_lor, Nat.testBit_shiftLeft, Nat.testBit_two_pow_mul_add _ hd']
  rcases lt_or_ge i 5 with hi | hi
  · have h1 : ¬(i ≥ 5) := by omega

    have h4 : ¬(i < 5) := by omega
    simp [hi, h3, h4]

def encode5Bytes (b0 b1 b2 b3 b4 : UInt8) : Bytes :=
  let val : Nat :=
    b0.toNat * 2^32 + b1.toNat * 2^24 + b2.toNat * 2^16 + b3.toNat * 2^8 + b4.toNat
  [ b32AlphabetGet ((val >>> 35) &&& 0x1F),
    b32AlphabetGet ((val >>> 30) &&& 0x1F),
    b32AlphabetGet ((val >>> 25) &&& 0x1F),
    b32AlphabetGet ((val >>> 20) &&& 0x1F),
    b32AlphabetGet ((val >>> 15) &&& 0x1F),
    b32AlphabetGet ((val >>> 10) &&& 0x1F),
    b32AlphabetGet ((val >>> 5) &&& 0x1F),
    b32AlphabetGet (val &&& 0x1F) ]

def b32encode : Bytes → Bytes
  | [] => []
  | [b0] => (encode5Bytes b0 0 0 0 0).take 2 ++ [61, 61, 61, 61, 61, 61]
  | [b0, b1] => (encode5Bytes b0 b1 0 0 0).take 4 ++ [61, 61, 61, 61]
  | [b0, b1, b2] => (encode5Bytes b0 b1 b2 0 0).take 5 ++ [61, 61, 61]
  | [b0, b1, b2, b3] => (encode5Bytes b0 b1 b2 b3 0).take 7 ++ [61]
  | b0 :: b1 :: b2 :: b3 :: b4 :: rest =>

def rstripEq : Bytes → Bytes
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs =>
    match rstripEq xs with
    | [] => if x == 61 then [] else [x]
    | r => x :: r

theorem rstripEq_cons_of_ne (x : UInt8) (xs : Bytes) (h : (x == 61) = false) :

def decodeLoop : Bytes → Nat → Nat → Option Bytes
  | [], _, _ => some []
  | c :: cs, val, bits =>

    | none => none
    | some d =>
      let val' := (val <<< 5) ||| d
      let bits' := bits + 5
      if bits' ≥ 8 then
        let bits'' := bits' - 8
        let byte := UInt8.ofNat ((val' >>> bits'') &&& 0xFF)
        match decodeLoop cs val' bits'' with
        | none => none
        | some rest => some (byte :: rest)
      else
        decodeLoop cs val' bits'

    ∀ val : Nat, decodeLoop (rstripEq (b32encode s)) val 0 = some s := by
  induction s using b32encode.induct with
  | case1 => intro val; rfl
  | case2 b0 =>
    intro val
    have hb0 := b0.toNat_lt
    simp only [b32encode, encode5Bytes, List.take, List.cons_append, List.nil_append,

    apply decodeLoop_7 <;> { simp only [Nat.shiftRight_eq_div_pow, nat_and_31, UInt8.toNat_zero]; omega }
  | case6 b0 b1 b2 b3 b4 rest ih =>
